headline: Four new DEX APIs feed pricing consensus, Safety Score hits v6.0, and live reserves double to 114 coins.
fieldNotes: Most of the week went into widening what each number rests on. Four direct DEX APIs and four more price sources now feed consensus, which also stopped treating DefiLlama as an independent vote. Live reserve tracking reached 114 coins and redemption backstops 136. Chain profiles opened a second way to read supply, and the week closed with audit remediation across cron, digest, and backstop pipelines.

summary.label: Chain analytics launch
summary.description: New /chains/ leaderboard and per-chain profile pages with health scores, supply snapshots, and cross-linked stablecoin detail

summary.label: Multi-DEX API integration
summary.description: Fluid, Balancer, Raydium, and Orca direct API fetchers with per-protocol price disaggregation into pricing consensus

summary.label: Pricing source expansion
summary.description: Kraken, Bitstamp, Jupiter, and Chainlink added to consensus; DefiLlama no longer counts as an independent source; tertiary FX fallback for multi-source outages

summary.label: Safety Score v6.0
summary.description: Custody tiers, mature-alt-L1 classification, 2-factor Resilience scoring, and custodyModel overrides for all remaining coins

summary.label: Live reserve expansion
summary.description: Coverage expanded from 54 to 114 coins with curated-validated adapters, display blocks, and risk validation

summary.label: Redemption backstop coverage
summary.description: Expanded from 66 to 136 coins with BUIDL, NAV-based, AMM, and on-chain backstop configs plus fee accuracy fixes

summary.label: Pre-launch module
summary.description: New /upcoming page with milestone tracking, Telegram launch alerts, pre-launch detail views, a homepage timeline, and seven seeded pre-launch stablecoins

summary.label: Stablecoin additions
summary.description: thBILL, Alto DUSD, USSD, and USBD added to tracking; dUSD gains a prominent exploit notice banner

summary.label: Table and page polish
summary.description: Table density toggle, column resize, context menus, command palette history, richer OG share images, and design-system utilities across ten routes
